schedule_requests: schedule requests for processing in a single forward pass of the vLLM model
update_from_output: update scheduler state based on model runner output including generated token ids and draft token ids
add_request: add a new request to the scheduler's internal queue for processing
finish_requests: finish requests in the scheduler queue by request id with a specified finished status
reset_prefix_cache: reset the KV cache prefix cache for the scheduler optionally preempting running requests
